headline: SSH rule opens to the entire internet instead of restricting to on-call rotation — brute-force attacks on port 22 will start immediately.

findings.evidence_ref: Ingress rule in the diff: `cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]` for port 22 SSH access
findings.explanation: The implementation opens SSH to 0.0.0.0/0 (the entire internet) rather than restricting to the on-call rotation's IP addresses or IAM identities. This exposes app instances to immediate brute-force attacks and reconnaissance.
